 Williamson has been ruled out by the Pels for their Monday road game, as they will let the star big man take a rest.
 Zion Williamson to take a rest for Pelicans vs. Warriors
 The New Orleans Pelicans will play the second night of their back-to-back games this Monday. They are coming off a 139-123 loss on Sunday against the Clippers in LA.
 As such, the Pelicans will give Williamson a break to avoid potential injuries, who dropped 25 points in 31 minutes this past weekend. The NBA star will likely rejoin the team on Wednesday's home game against the Brooklyn Nets.
 Derik Queen, Saddiq Bey and Herbert Jones are all set for increased responsibilities with Williamson sidelined.
 Williamson is averaging 21.0 points, 5.3 rebounds, and 2.7 assists across 10 games played so far this season.
 NOLA holds a 4-6 record entering Monday's matchup in Golden State.
